description: Two signals bent by one of three shaping curves, in 2HP, with the amount of bend under one knob and CV

params.text: Sets how far the shaping goes, straight through in the centre, one way counter-clockwise and the other clockwise
Attenuates and inverts the modulation CV between -100% and +100%, and comes up at 0%
Chooses the curve: 5Sine thins the peaks one way and rounds them the other, Knee bends the signal about a hard corner, Clamp/Fold flattens the peaks one way and folds them the other
Chooses what range the shaping is worked out over: A learns it from the signal as it arrives, B fixes it at -5V to 5V, U fixes it at 0V to 10V

inputs.text: Moves the shaping, 5V covering half the knob's travel at full trim; a polyphonic signal here shapes each channel by its own amount
A rising edge throws away the range learnt so far in the A position, so it is learnt again from what arrives next
One of the two signals to be shaped

outputs.text: Carries that input shaped, with the same number of channels

notes: with the shaping knob centred and no CV, the module passes the input through unchanged apart from the clipping range
in the A range position the curve depends on what the module has heard so far, so a signal that was loud and then goes quiet needs a reset
menu: Auto Scale/offset-mode: Individual (per section), Common (both sections) — chooses whether the two sections learn their ranges separately or share one, which suits a stereo pair
Oversampling mode: Single sample, 2x oversampling — runs the shaping at twice the sample rate, which is worth it on audio and off unless you turn it on
Quantize mode — rounds the output to the nearest step of the size chosen, from a twelfth of a volt up to 5V, and is Off unless you set it
Clipping range — clamps every output to the range chosen, -12V to 12V unless you change it, and Off lets the output run to any voltage
Process quality: Audio, High, Balanced, Low, Very low — sets how often the module runs its algorithm, from every cycle down to every 256th; below Balanced a 1ms trigger can be missed

inputs.1:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
